# Ordinance No. 005, Series of 2003

**Ordinance Creating the Position of Local Legislative Staff Employee II**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the position of Local Legislative Staff Employee II within the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] office of Pitogo, Quezon. It defines the functions, duties, and responsibilities of the position and allocates funding for it in the supplemental budget for [[2003]]. The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** The position of Local Legislative Staff Employee II is created in the office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon, with salary grade 4 in the plantilla of personnel schedule.
2.  **Section 2.** Function, Duties and Responsibilities:
    1.  File and record all pertinent resolution such as Approved Resolutions & Ordinances of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].
    2.  File all important communication coming from different agencies of the government.
    3.  Assist in making Resolution and Ordinances.
3.  **Section 3.** The corresponding appropriation for the said position shall be included in the Supplemental Budget CY [[2003]].
4.  **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
5.  **Section 5.** Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon this 3rd day of March, [[2003]].
